You can't attach OpenSearchIngestionSelfManagedVpcePolicy to your IAM entities.
This policy is attached to a service-linked role that allows OpenSearch Ingestion to enable self-
managed VPC access for ingestion pipelines, create tags, and publish ingestion-related CloudWatch
metrics to your account. For more information, see the section called “Using service-linked roles”.
You can ﬁnd the OpenSearchIngestionSelfManagedVpcePolicy policy in the IAM console.

hierarchy.parent: AWS managed policies for Amazon OpenSearch Service
